name: caranguejada
description: Jogo multiplayer de navegador: caranguejos, maré subindo e empurrões.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @caranguejada/server" "npm run dev -w @caranguejada/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @caranguejada/client && npm run build -w @caranguejada/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
